facts.name: M.S. study areas and culminating options
facts.detail: Department degree-programs page: the M.S. includes advanced study and research in areas such as AI, machine learning, and software engineering, with a thesis project or a comprehensive exam.
facts.quote: Graduates of the Master of Science in Computer Science program at San Diego State University engage in advanced study and research in various computing domains, including artificial intelligence, machine learning, and software engineering.

facts.name: Thesis or comprehensive exam
facts.detail: Students may complete a thesis project with faculty or a comprehensive exam.
facts.quote: Students may choose to either complete a thesis project, collaborating closely with faculty on innovative research that addresses real-world problems, or opt for a comprehensive exam to fulfill their degree requirements.

facts.name: No letters, SOP, or resumes
facts.detail: University master's-degrees page, Computer Science, M.S. section: the department does not require or consider letters of recommendation, statements of purpose, or resumes.
facts.quote: The Computer Science Department does not require nor take into consideration letters of recommendation, statements of purpose, or resumes.
